column1: Agent-Determined Parameters — Resolved Live by the Data Agent / SE Daily Planner Agent, Not Fixed in Config

These items were left as "custom"/blank by the business and have not yet received a fixed answer. Rather than blocking on a fixed number, the agents below resolve each one from live data at query time. Safety rules (🔒, e.g. 3.7) are excluded from this list on purpose — they stay hard-coded and are never agent-determined.

column4: Runtime Resolution Logic (Data Agent / SE Daily Planner Agent)

column3: Growth requirement is not a fixed number — instead, require x% growth tied to the AOP target
column4: Data Agent computes the required growth % dynamically per DC/territory from the live AOP growth assumption for that quarter, rather than one fixed percentage

column3: Variable / not fixed — condition: DC-to-SE mapping must first be corrected (no under-mapping or over-mapping) before an effort multiplier is meaningful
column4: SE Daily Planner Agent checks live DC-to-SE mapping-quality status each query; once mapping is confirmed clean, it derives the multiplier from the SE's trailing 3-month visit trend rather than a fixed 1.25x, and surfaces a mapping-correction alert instead of a target while mapping is still flagged dirty

column3: Weighted average of coverage % and effort % (not multiplication)
column4: Agent weights Coverage vs. Effort dynamically each query based on whichever is further behind its target that period — the bigger gap gets more weight that day, instead of a fixed split

column3: Inactive/closed DCs excluded; additionally factor in supply-chain variable cost as an exclusion consideration
column4: Data Agent computes supply-chain variable cost per DC at query time (freight distance, delivery frequency, order size) and excludes outlier-cost DCs relative to their route/cluster, instead of one fixed ₹ threshold

column3: For an overdue (OD) DC, the SE should still visit (not fully blocked); only a legal/compliance hold removes the DC from all lists entirely
column4: Agent always blocks DCs under Legal_Hold. For Credit_Blocked/Blacklisted DCs, it now reads the confirmed sale_orderrequest.credit_on_hold / credit_on_hold_reason fields directly (previously described only as "live OD status and SE/DC communication notes" with no concrete source) to decide visit-eligibility case by case

column3: Rule (b) explicitly confirmed — all-D reorder to Visits, PL, Overall Sales, Outstanding, Long-Term. Rule (a) [Outstanding=D caps Overall Sales at B] not explicitly re-confirmed
column4: Agent applies rule (a) by default as a conservative precaution and flags 'applying default override, please confirm' in its output until the business explicitly turns it off

column3: Visit-before-PL-order rule retained; add: maximum discount the SE/system may offer (% not yet specified) and DC approval required in-system before order creation
column4: Agent applies the last-approved discount ceiling for that DC's category as a conservative default, and routes any exception to a human for approval before the SE is told to offer it — this one stays close to a safety rule even though it's agent-assisted
